sentences.text:
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh 18.04. 2022 item No.42 n.b.
ct. no. 34 CRR 359 of 2013 + IA No. CRAN 1 of 2013(Old No. CRAN 366 of 2013) Smt. K. Das Gupta & Anr.
Vs. State of West Bengal & Anr.
Mr. Anwar Hossain, Ms. Manisha Sharma .....for the State None appears for the petitioners or for the State.
Mr. Anwar Hossain, learned advocate is directed to appear on behalf of the State.
His appointment may be regularised by the concerned authority.

Learned advocate for the State is directed to submit a status report through any officer deputed by the Officer in Charge New Market Police Station regarding fate of the case no. 17-D of 1986 under Section 16(1)(a)(I) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
Needless to state that there was an order of conviction and sentence, as such the officer submitting the report should appraise the Court regarding the fact whether sentence has been executed or not.
Such report be submitted by 3rd of May 2022.

List the revisional under the heading "Adjourned Matters"
on 4.5.2022.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
